title: Bodycam Video Shows Shootout Between Rochester Police Officers and Homicide Suspect
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Rochester, N.Y. — On June 22, 2025, at 11:40 a.m., Rochester Police Officers located 35-year-old Edison Estremera-Cohen riding a bike on N. Clinton Ave. Officers had information that he had previously shot and killed David Vazquez, 30, at 24 Oscar St, earlier in the day. During the apprehension, Estremera-Cohen pulled out a 9mm handgun and fired one round in the direction of an Officer from inches away. A second Officer returned fire, striking Estremera-Cohen multiple times. After being hospitalized for his injuries, Estremera-Cohen was booked on June 26, in the Monroe County Jail. Estremera-Cohen has since been indicted by a Grand Jury for two counts of Murder in the 2nd Degree, Attempted Aggravated Murder of a Police Officer, Robbery in the 1st Degree, and four counts of Criminal Possession of a Weapon in the 2nd Degree. Estremera-Cohen was known to law enforcement and never showed up for sentencing after being convicted of two felonies last summer. The third officer, who narrowly avoided gunfire, had head and ear injuries from the muzzle flash on Estremera-Cohen's gun, but the officer was "doing well" according to Rochester Police Chief David Smith.
